string.name: addon_lan_unsupported
string.value: This device does not support mDNS.

string.name: addon_lan_trust
string.value: When enabled, devices on the same LAN can discover this service and its listening port. Use only on a trusted network and set login credentials for the service.

string.name: addon_lan_lifetime
string.value: Announcements are off by default and apply only while the app process is running. Advertising does not start the service. Stopping the service withdraws its announcement.

string.name: addon_lan_exposure
string.value: LAN announcements never open a public port. Prefer a VPN for remote access.

string.name: addon_lan_waiting
string.value: Waiting for the local service to start

string.name: addon_lan_withdraw_failed
string.value: Withdrawal of the announcement for port %d was not confirmed. Try again.

string.name: addon_lan_registration_failed
string.value: Could not register the LAN announcement. Try again.
